title: Payment integrity leakage triage without raw claims
summary: A strategy-stage payment integrity diagnostic can use aggregated denial categories, recoverable value bands, payer/service-line groupings, provider-pattern summaries, and confidence/effort scoring without raw claim lines or member identifiers.
guardrails: do not rank individual providers without attribution review
do not use raw claim IDs or member identifiers
human review required before provider-facing recommendation

title: Prior authorization modernization strategy pattern
summary: Prior auth strategy should separate workflow triage, payer/API readiness, clinical criteria governance, CMS interoperability constraints, and physician burden reduction before recommending automation scope.
guardrails: do not automate clinical determinations without approved governance
do not use raw medical records in strategy phases
human approval required for workflow scope
recommended_outputs: decision log for clinical and compliance gates

title: Provider quality HEDIS STAR strategy pattern
summary: Provider quality strategy requires measure-family selection, attribution confidence, intervention ownership, care-gap operating model, and quality bonus exposure before dashboards or provider comparisons are trusted.
evidence_needed: covered lives or risk pool summary
guardrails: do not publish provider rankings without attribution review
do not use patient-level gaps in strategy materials
show confidence and missing evidence

title: Member experience contact center strategy without raw transcripts
summary: Contact center strategy can start with queue volumes, abandon rates, resolution drivers, intent taxonomy, escalation paths, and synthetic or redacted examples instead of raw transcripts or CRM notes.
guardrails: do not upload raw call transcripts
do not include member names emails phone numbers or IDs
use human-reviewed redaction samples only

title: Cost transparency strategy pattern
summary: Cost transparency for a health plan should connect aggregated cost-of-care, contract, finance, provider, product, and population lenses through a governed metric model before claiming exact margin or actuarial ROI.
guardrails: do not present unaudited numbers as final financials
do not require raw claims for strategy diagnosis
show data-lineage confidence

title: Governed healthcare data foundation strategy pattern
summary: A strategy-stage lakehouse or semantic-layer move should focus on data-product ownership, quality scores, refresh SLAs, PHI classification, evidence lineage, and AI-readiness criteria rather than moving sensitive raw datasets.
guardrails: minimum necessary data only
no raw EMR claims pharmacy data for P0-P4
separate execution data request if operational validation is later approved

title: Automated close and reporting strategy pattern
summary: Finance close automation should begin with close calendar, reconciliation controls, reporting inventory, manual effort hotspots, data lineage, and controller-approved evidence before recommending automation.
guardrails: do not use unaudited actuals as final claims
controller approval required for finance metrics
show evidence gaps explicitly
